q1_issues.issue: The existential claim is carried only by a dormant per-member Implication: no swim event (and no group-level event) is ever asserted, and no member is individuated, so nothing in the parse states that any penguin actually swims in lava.
'now' is dropped — no Time atom (or any other trace) records the stated deictic.
genetic_engineering is a fused compound kind whose head-noun genus (Inheritance genetic_engineering engineering) is mandatory under Compound concepts but is not emitted.

q2_gaps: restrictive relative clause on an existential bare plural ('there are Ns that V') — the instruction set covers participial post-modifiers and relative clauses inside rule premises, but gives no rule for whether such an NP becomes a witness/group with an asserted event or a distribution rule

attribution PP 'thanks to NP' with an entity complement (same family as 'because of NP'): the connective section is clause-to-clause only, and the preposition-named oblique is defined for PPs naming what an activity is about or directed at, not for a cause/enabler attached to an entity
a temporal deictic modifying an existential state ('there are NOW Ns') — Time atoms are specified to attach to an event witness, and no eventuality is reified for 'there are'
notes: ThanksTo is treated as licensed by analogy with the entity-attached preposition case ('wool from Calderwick' -> (From ...)), but the instruction set never sanctions that route for a causal/enabling PP. The rule's Skolem-function shape, Agent for swim, Location for 'in lava', and the 1.0/0.9 strength all follow the distribution-rule conventions.
